scope: Machine-checkable MVP subset of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 for retail pre-packaged commodity inspection. This is not a complete legal corpus.

rules.requirement: Chapter II applies to retail packages subject to the exclusions in Rule 3.
exceptions: Rule 3 exclusions must be evaluated before Chapter II declaration rules.
manual_review_conditions: Missing or conflicting package quantity, package type, commodity category, or consumer type.

rules.requirement: Required manufacturer/packer/importer identity and address declaration, subject to the rule's category-specific provisions.
exceptions: Category-specific provisions and declarations under other applicable law must be evaluated.
manual_review_conditions: Identity/address text is incomplete, ambiguous, or category-specific treatment is unresolved.

rules.requirement: Imported packages require the applicable country-of-origin declaration.
manual_review_conditions: Import status is unknown or declaration cannot be reliably parsed.

rules.requirement: The common or generic name of the commodity must be declared; multi-product packages have additional treatment.
manual_review_conditions: Commodity identity or multi-product status is ambiguous.

rules.requirement: Consumer-care contact information must be declared as prescribed.
manual_review_conditions: Contact information is incomplete or cannot be reliably classified.

rules.requirement: Net quantity/number must be declared in the prescribed representation and standard units, subject to Rule 12 exceptions.
exceptions: Rule 12 and the Fourth Schedule provide exceptions for specified commodities.
manual_review_conditions: Commodity-specific unit exception cannot be resolved.
Quantity text is uncertain or conflicting.

rules.requirement: The unit used for quantity declaration must follow Rule 12 and its exceptions.
exceptions: Fourth Schedule exceptions must be considered.
manual_review_conditions: Commodity-specific exception or Fourth Schedule mapping is unresolved.

rules.requirement: The applicable date declaration required by Rule 6 must be present and legible, subject to applicable exceptions/other law.
exceptions: Do not infer applicability where another applicable law governs the declaration.
manual_review_conditions: Date text is ambiguous or category-specific exception is unresolved.

rules.requirement: Best-before/use-by declaration is checked when applicable under Rule 6.
manual_review_conditions: Applicability cannot be established from available commodity context.

rules.requirement: Maximum retail sale price must be declared as prescribed.
manual_review_conditions: MRP text is missing, conflicting, or unreadable.

rules.requirement: MRP must be expressed in the prescribed form and inclusive of applicable taxes.
manual_review_conditions: MRP format or tax-inclusive wording cannot be reliably determined.

rules.requirement: MRP numerals must satisfy the applicable minimum height requirements in Rule 7.
exceptions: For packages containing medical devices, the Medical Devices Rules, 2017 apply to numeral height under G.S.R. 778(E), effective 23 October 2025.
manual_review_conditions: No reliable physical calibration.
Medical-device applicability unresolved.

rules.requirement: Required declarations must be placed on the principal display panel as prescribed.
manual_review_conditions: Principal display panel cannot be reliably established from the image.

rules.requirement: Applicable numerals and letters must meet the minimum height prescribed by Rule 7.
exceptions: Medical-device packages use Medical Devices Rules, 2017 for height under G.S.R. 778(E).
manual_review_conditions: No reliable physical calibration.
Required panel-area category is unavailable.

rules.requirement: Applicable numeral/letter width requirements must be satisfied where prescribed by Rule 7.
exceptions: Medical-device packages use Medical Devices Rules, 2017 for width under G.S.R. 778(E).
manual_review_conditions: No reliable physical calibration.

rules.requirement: Relevant declarations must satisfy the prescribed visibility/contrast requirements.
manual_review_conditions: Image quality or lighting prevents reliable contrast assessment.

rules.requirement: Declarations must remain clear and legible under the conditions prescribed by Rule 9.
manual_review_conditions: Glare, blur, occlusion, liquid visibility, handwriting, or wrapper conditions cannot be reliably assessed.

rules.requirement: Where the outer package carries the declarations required by the rules, the prescribed treatment of inner packages must be respected.
manual_review_conditions: Inner/outer package relationship cannot be established.

rules.requirement: Commodities specified in the Second Schedule must follow the applicable standard quantities; non-standard sizes require the prescribed prominent declaration.
exceptions: The Second Schedule and applicable commodity-specific provisions must be consulted.
manual_review_conditions: Commodity is not confidently mapped to the Second Schedule.

rules.requirement: For grouped packages sold as a retail promotional package, every package in the group must comply with Rule 6.
manual_review_conditions: Individual package declarations cannot be inspected.

rules.requirement: Unit sale price must be declared on applicable retail packages and on the principal display panel, subject to exemptions.
exceptions: The FAQ identifies exemptions including packages of 10 ml/10 g or less and wholesale packages; Rule 6(11) exemptions must be evaluated from the current rule text.
manual_review_conditions: Exemption applicability cannot be established.

rules.requirement: Unit sale price is inclusive of all taxes and is rounded to the nearest two decimal places; a whole number may be shown without decimal places.
manual_review_conditions: Quantity basis or displayed price cannot be reliably parsed.

rules.requirement: Individual stickers used to provide certain mandatory information are restricted; a single label carrying the required information is treated differently under the FAQ.
exceptions: The DCA FAQ notes an exception for an individual sticker declaring reduced MRP where the original MRP declaration is not covered.
manual_review_conditions: Image evidence does not reliably distinguish a permitted label from a prohibited individual sticker.

rules.requirement: An e-commerce entity must display the mandatory Rule 6(1) declarations online, except the month and year of manufacture/packing, subject to the marketplace provisions.
exceptions: Marketplace responsibility provisions in Rule 6(10) apply.
manual_review_conditions: Marketplace model or listing responsibility cannot be established.

rules.requirement: E-commerce entities selling imported products must provide product listings in a searchable and sortable filter specifying country of origin.
manual_review_conditions: Imported status or filter evidence is unavailable.

temporal_notes: G.S.R. 312(E), 27 April 2026, is effective from 2027-07-01 and therefore is not applied to the September 2026 baseline.
G.S.R. 778(E), 23 October 2025, provides Medical Devices Rules, 2017 treatment for medical-device declarations and numeral/letter dimensions.
implementation_notes: Applicability is data-driven; validators must not silently hard-code legal scope conditions that are represented here.
Unknown applicability, missing evidence, conflicting extraction, or unreliable physical measurement must not become PASS.
effective_from/effective_to are registry selection dates and must be reviewed against the cited amendment/version before production legal deployment.
This registry is an engineering MVP subset. The complete Rules Map, commodity schedules, exceptions, and amendment history remain outside this file until verified.
